summary: Allow a surface to use the existing local backdrop-sampling edge
expected: Expose the existing auto/local edge mode on Vue and React UiSurface, matching UiControlSurface, so a consumer can choose the shared CSS backdrop filter instead of a fixed-colour outline.
acceptanceCriteria: UiSurface defaults to automatic edge rendering and exposes local mode through the existing shared CSS edge path in Vue and React.
XCA Portal opts only its light navbar into the local backdrop-filter edge; explicit dark and system-dark retain the existing automatic renderer.
The light edge filters the real backdrop without a fixed white border or changes to shared Glass body blur, dark rendering, renderer composition or scheduling.
System preference changes update the header edge mode and synchronize the existing shared renderer.

consumers.scenario: Light navbar edge should brighten the actual colour behind it while the dark navbar stays unchanged.

resolution: Consumer chose to keep the current appearance and requested no further changes; no implementation was made.
